articles.title: Pro-rated charges when changing plans
articles.summary: Explains how credits and charges apply when upgrading or downgrading mid-cycle.
articles.snippet: Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing period unless you enable immediate downgrade; duplicate charges are usually pending authorizations that release within 3–5 business days.

articles.title: Safari SSO troubleshooting
articles.summary: Steps for ITP and third-party cookie issues with SAML/OIDC on Safari.
articles.snippet: Clear site data, allow cross-site tracking for the IdP domain, and verify redirect URI matches the Safari-tested allowlist.

articles.title: API status and incident communications
articles.summary: How to subscribe to incidents and when enterprise hotline applies.
articles.snippet: Enterprise customers receive bridge invites for SEV-1 incidents; reference status.example.com and your account TAM for concurrent issues.
